name: Tasklet
description: Cloud agent platform with a hosted MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex can delegate tasks to your Tasklet agents and check their progress. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Delegate to Tasklet Agents
skills.description: Hand a task to one of your Tasklet agents, which does it with its own connections, skills and permissions.

skills.name: Check Agent Progress
skills.description: Read threads in connected Tasklet agents to check progress on a task and send follow-ups.

skills.name: Copy Skills to Agents
skills.description: Copy skills you built in Claude Code or Codex to a Tasklet agent so it and its sharers can reuse them.
